fields.name: image
fields.label: Car image
fields.description: Fills the left half of the block (on phones: a banner above the form).

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.description: E.g. RESERVE NOW.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: Shown under the heading.

fields.name: submitLabel
fields.label: Button text
fields.description: E.g. PROCEED.

fields.name: submitAction
fields.label: Send the form to (URL)
fields.description: The form data is posted there as JSON ({ data: { firstName, … } }). Leave empty to only show the confirmation message.

fields.name: successMessage
fields.label: Confirmation message
fields.description: Replaces the form once it has been sent.

fields.name: disclaimer
fields.label: Privacy disclaimer
fields.description: Small print under the button, e.g. “… or request erasure anytime at”. The contact email and the privacy notice link follow it, each with a full stop.

fields.name: privacyEmail
fields.label: Privacy contact email
fields.description: Shown as a link after the disclaimer: the address as mailto:…, e.g. mailto:privacy@jswmotors.com.

fields.name: privacyEmailText
fields.label: Privacy contact email text
fields.description: E.g. privacy@jswmotors.com.

fields.name: privacyLinkText
fields.label: Privacy notice link text
fields.description: E.g. Full Privacy Notice.

fields.name: amountLabel
fields.label: Amount label
fields.description: Shown on the price card over the image, e.g. RESERVATION AMOUNT. Leave the amount empty to hide the card.

fields.name: amount
fields.label: Reservation amount (₹)
fields.description: In rupees, e.g. 10000 (shown as ₹10,000). Also the amount charged when no payment service is set; with one, the service's amount is charged, so keep the two the same.

fields.name: amountBadge
fields.label: Amount badge
fields.description: The small outlined tag beside the label, e.g. REFUNDABLE. Optional.

fields.name: amountNote
fields.label: Amount note
fields.description: Under the amount, e.g. Total payable today. Refundable until you confirm your order.

fields.name: razorpayKeyId
fields.label: Razorpay Key ID
fields.description: The PUBLIC key only (rzp_test_… or rzp_live_…). NEVER enter the Key Secret here: this page is public and anyone could read it. The secret belongs only in the payment service's settings. Leave empty to send the form without a payment.

fields.name: paymentService
fields.label: Payment service URL
fields.description: The address of the payment service that creates the orders and verifies the payments with the Key Secret, e.g. https://jsw-payments.example.workers.dev. Without it, payments are not verified (test mode only).

fields.name: merchantName
fields.label: Name in the payment window
fields.description: E.g. JSW Motors. The amount label is shown under it.

fields.name: successPage
fields.label: Page after a successful payment
fields.description: E.g. the Confirmation page (default: /confirmation).

fields.name: failurePage
fields.label: Page after a failed payment
fields.description: E.g. the Payment Failed page (default: /payment-failed).

fields.name: title
fields.label: Section name
fields.description: E.g. User Details. Groups the fields that follow it (up to the next section); read out by screen readers as the group's name (not shown in the design).

fields.name: label
fields.label: Label
fields.description: Shown inside the field and read out by screen readers, e.g. First Name (required fields get a * added). The field’s kind follows its name: an email address, a mobile / phone number (with the +91 box) or text; first and last name sit side by side.

fields.name: fieldName
fields.label: Field name
fields.description: Key of this value in the sent data, e.g. firstName. Leave empty to make it from the label.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Label
fields.description: Shown in the dropdown until a choice is made, e.g. Select City (a required one gets a * added).

fields.name: fieldName
fields.label: Field name
fields.description: Key of the choice in the sent data, e.g. city. Leave empty to make it from the label.

fields.name: options
fields.label: Cities
fields.description: The dropdown’s choices: add a city per entry, edit, reorder or remove them here.
